_comment: City Brain, garbage-bin axis only, with the mock Twin and mock Guardian over HTTP. Every garbage setting is written out with its default value. Tokens: environment variables BRAIN_TOKEN and TWIN_TOKEN (16 characters or more).

city._comment_decision: trucks = plan routes and send dispatch_truck; crew = the Twin empties a bin on request (City Ground Zero)
city._comment_colours: red >= red_pct; green < green_pct; orange = will reach red_pct before the next pass; yellow otherwise
city._comment_readings: the Twin sends every bin every reading_interval_s; silent for silence_factor x that = suspect
city._comment_trucks: depot = a node of the map; only the first of horizon_stops planned stops is sent
